subject: ClinicX triage assistant pilot — scope, technical asks, and next steps
messages:
From: Dr. Laura Chen <laura@clinicx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Cole <marcus.cole@clinicx.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — triage assistant pilot

Priya — thanks for the time today. Quick notes from our side to make sure we captured the scope correctly:

- Goal: Reduce triage time for incoming clinic messages by surfacing structured summaries and a ranked set of suggested actions for nurses.
- Must-haves: JSON structured output (diagnosis code, urgency, suggested routing), near-real-time responses (<600ms median on US region), and a safe fallback when model is uncertain.
- Nice-to-have: Embedding-based rerank for historical note retrieval; streaming partial responses so UI shows progressive summary.
- Security: PHI will never be stored outside our environment; we'll need support for Private deployment or explicit contractual terms about data handling.

Next steps on our side: confirm procurement window (we're targeting July budget approval) and share a subset of anonymized triage examples (will redact PHI).

—Laura
Dr. Laura Chen
Head of Clinical Ops, ClinicX
laura@clinicx.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Laura Chen <laura@clinicx.com>
Cc: Marcus Cole <marcus.cole@clinicx.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — triage assistant pilot

Laura / Marcus — great to meet you both. Appreciate the clear priorities — wrote up a concise recap and proposed next steps below. Please flag anything I missed.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary objective: reduce manual triage time and routing errors by delivering structured JSON outputs + ranked action suggestions.
- Latency target: median <600ms in US; 95th percentile target to be agreed during pilot.
- Data flow: ClinicX sends redacted triage texts to Redwood through Private (VPC) or Hosted with guaranteed retention rules.
- Quality: require rerank over embeddings for retrieving similar historical cases; structured outputs validated via a small eval set.

Technical asks (Redwood commitments for pilot)
1) SDK changes: small client helper to stream partial JSON pieces and to emit structured-field confidence scores.
2) Function calling: enable safe, typed funcalls for generate->structured JSON output with built-in validation hooks.
3) Streaming: support progressive tokens for the summary UI; ability to cancel on the client.
4) Reranking: provide an embeddings + MMR reranker blueprint; we will ship a test embeddings index for the pilot.
5) Fallbacks & policy: automatic fallback to a smaller, cheaper model when headroom constrained; logging to audit decisions.

Proposed pilot plan
- Week 0: sign pilot SOW and NDA (attached).
- Week 1: data exchange (anonymized examples) + infra access for Redwood engineers.
- Week 2–4: integration iteration — SDK + funcall prototype, streaming UI demo, rerank baseline.
- Week 5: evaluation on the held-out set + quality review with ClinicX clinical team.

Immediate asks for ClinicX
- Send 200–300 redacted triage examples (CSV) by Friday (July 3).
- Confirm whether Private deployment is required for pilot or if Hosted with retention controls is acceptable.

Attachments included: pilot dataset spec (template) and draft SOW.

I'll loop Ben to cover pricing and Sergio to lead the technical on-ramps.

Thanks — talk soon.

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Discovery call — triage assistant pilot

Marcus / Laura — quick commercial note so procurement has context.

Pilot pricing options (summary)
- Option A (Hosted pilot): 6 weeks, $6,500 flat pilot fee + usage (discounted) — includes access to our hosted environment and support for SDK changes.
- Option B (Private pilot): 6 weeks, $12,000 flat pilot fee + infrastructure setup — for VPC/private deployments; includes one on-call infra engineer and KMS integration support.

Both pilots include up to 10k inference units (sufficient for the pilot run) and one technical onboarding call per week. If ClinicX wants a longer evaluation or production readiness guarantee, we can convert to a reserved-capacity proposal after the pilot.

If procurement needs a narrower SOW or a statement of work for legal, we can produce a trimmed version. Priya — can you confirm SOW filename we just shared?

Ben Carter
